track: Android pointer capture loss and regain
hypothesis: After OS revokes capture without Unity focus callback, requested and previously observed motion leave legacy axis hijacked to zero; native status polling and generational lease with loss-reset must restore fallback and allow reacquisition without double injection.
approach: Introduce pure C# generational capture-lease gate with frame-atomic movement and executable positive/negative transition controls; use UI-thread hasPointerCapture sampling and captured listener to confirm acceptance/loss and invalidate stale async callbacks. Keep original source patch, touch, save/UGUI, native request permissions unchanged; reuse dedicated source-only CI.
next_step: T5 next signed APK/OBB: validate OS grant/loss/regrant and relative look, focus/menu/Escape/unplug and world/save/exit/reopen regression on POCO F5 Pro; source-only CI not proof of device.

result.controls: 24 Python source-free plus 13 .NET motion controls; original Unity2021 ABI compile and original 4+4+2 private staged patch
result.limits: No physical OS pointer-capture confirmation; original user save/reopen remains bounded to old signed candidate.

implementation_note: Requested pure lease helper blocked by tool checks; final bounded fix uses existing bridge captureGate, epoch-protected UI probes and positive hasPointerCapture rather than adding helper.
